notes: The summon framework exists globally but no summon is unlocked, assigned, or usable in the opening vertical slice.
Future summons may use MP or another resource, but that resource must be declared per summon.
Summon attacks may target all enemies without exposing enemy HP, percentages, or health bars.
Presentation hooks are intentionally data-driven so Unity can provide model, animation, VFX, audio, camera, and return-to-battle sequences later.
